dedupe_keys.name: comptage velo compteurs syndicat des mobilites de touraine

description: Comptage vélo - Compteurs - Syndicat des Mobilités de Touraine is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tours Métropole Val de Loire. Jeu de données listant et localisant les compteurs vélos gérés par le Syndicat des Mobilités de Touraine depuis 2016. Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are compteur, vélo, piste cyclable, bande cyclable. The portal shows 44 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
